design.note: 80 against a measured 89.9 (2026-07-26) leaves 9.9 points of margin, and the bar is deliberately NOT re-cut to track the score. The same untouched geometry has read 86.6, then 83.1, then 89.9, every move a correction to the ruler rather than a change to the part - the 83 bar that preceded this one survived the 2026-07-25 rework by 0.12 points, so a 0.6-point move in edge_break_coverage would have hard-failed the one part the skill tells agents to copy. A bar re-cut after every recalibration is a bar that has never been tested. 9.9 points absorbs the total loss of any two light metrics or a 47-point collapse in the heaviest one (edge_break_coverage at weight 0.21), while still holding this part 10 points above the repo's advisory gate of 70. See DESIGN.md 'Design review'.

assumptions: The mast bracket is a separate part; its bolt pattern is taken as 8 x M6 on the flange pad and has not been released.
The circular connector is represented by its panel cutout and mounting pattern only - no vendor STEP has been analysed.
The convection coefficient used for the thermal case is 6 W/m2K over the finned and plain external area, still air, no solar load on the finned face.
